query:

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims) as total_claims,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments) as total_assessments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments WHERE fraud_score IS NOT NULL) as with_fraud_score,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments WHERE repair_cost_estimate IS NOT NULL) as with_cost_estimate,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_approvals) as total_approvals,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_review_queue) as review_queue_items,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT claim_id) FROM claim_documents) as claims_with_docs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurer_tenants) as tenants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) as total_users;
